import orders from './orders.json' with {type:'json'};

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'order_status',
      description: 'Get the current status of an order by ID, optionally including chronological history.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          order_id: { type: 'string', description: 'The order identifier.' },
          include_history: { type: 'boolean', default: false, description: 'Whether to include chronological status history.' }
        },
        required: ['order_id'],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args = {}) {
  if (name !== 'order_status') {
    return {
      isError: true,
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Unknown tool: ${name}` }]
    };
  }

  // Validate arguments
  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    return {
      isError: true,
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Invalid arguments: expected an object.' }]
    };
  }

  const allowed = ['order_id', 'include_history'];
  const keys = Object.keys(args);
  const extra = keys.filter(k => !allowed.includes(k));
  if (extra.length > 0) {
    return {
      isError: true,
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Invalid arguments: unexpected field(s): ${extra.join(', ')}` }]
    };
  }

  if (!('order_id' in args) || typeof args.order_id !== 'string' || args.order_id === '') {
    return {
      isError: true,
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Invalid arguments: order_id is required and must be a non-empty string.' }]
    };
  }

  if ('include_history' in args && typeof args.include_history !== 'boolean') {
    return {
      isError: true,
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Invalid arguments: include_history must be a boolean.' }]
    };
  }

  const order_id = args.order_id;
  const include_history = args.include_history === true;

  if (!(order_id in orders)) {
    return {
      isError: true,
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Order not found: ${order_id}` }]
    };
  }

  const order = orders[order_id];
  const result = { order_id, status: order.status };
  if (include_history) {
    result.history = order.history;
  }

  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(result) }]
  };
}
